title: Repair core-dump suppression in the CI TS test runner
instruction: A regression landed in our CI TS test runner. Spawned chunks are no longer running with core dumps disabled, so a crashing chunk can fill the disk again. Restore the wrapper so every spawned test chunk runs with its core-dump limit disabled, keeps its PID for the watchdog, and still reports the chunk's own exit code.
acceptance_criteria: each spawned chunk reports zero as both its soft and hard core-dump limit
a chunk's failing exit code is still reported through the wrapper
